notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek and another artifact, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.
